# Notes index

Every distilled note is listed here, by name, with a link. The index is a
listing and not an entry, which is why it carries no frontmatter of its own —
and why a caller running the frontmatter check over `notes/*.md` must say
`--exempt index-` out loud rather than expect the tool to assume it.

- [lantern-care](lantern.md) — the glazing, the brass, and the two cloths
- [tide-tables](tides.md) — the jetty's eighteen minutes, and the sandbar
- [fog-signal](fog-signal.md) — compressor warm-up and the blast interval
